title: Fever (Pyrexia) — Dual-System Clinical Monograph
content:
Condition: Fever (Pyrexia). Body temperature > 100.4°F (38°C).
Allopathic Pharmacology (CDSCO/WHO Tier 1): Paracetamol (Acetaminophen) 500mg-650mg every 4-6 hours as needed (Max 4000mg/day). Mechanism: Central COX-2 inhibition in hypothalamus raising pain threshold and antipyresis. Contraindications: Severe hepatic impairment. Caution with alcohol.
Ayurvedic Formulations (AYUSH Tier 3): Maha Sudarshan Churna (3-5g twice daily with warm water) containing Kiratatikta to clear Ama (toxins) and balance Pitta-Kapha. Tribhuvan Kirti Rasa (1 tablet twice daily with ginger juice). Giloy / Guduchi (Tinospora cordifolia) Ghanavati 500mg twice daily for immune modulation and Jwarahara action.
Home Remedies & Supportive Care: Cold water sponging on forehead, Tulsi-Ginger-Black Pepper Kadha (decoction), hydration with coconut water, light Khichdi diet.
Emergency Red Flags: Fever > 103°F, stiff neck, shortness of breath, confusion, or fever lasting > 3 days requires immediate medical care.
